title: 我们已经在录制了  (We Are Already Taping)

segments.t: Convinced that Ji Xiu stole the backup plan from her splashed notebook, a tearful Bu Xiaogu apologises to Xingzi — only to learn a stunning secret: Twelve Singers is already taping right now! Listen first.
杏子姐，你在这儿干吗？
后备方案也行不通了！
杏子姐，是我，我要道歉。
道歉？道什么歉？
吉秀看到了，一定是我泄露了消息。
被我全搞砸了，我该怎么办啊？
你别哭啊，放心吧！
我们已经在录制了，担心都是多余的。
现在吗？复活赛不是明天才录吗？
Now let's unpack Xiaogu's apology and Xingzi's big reveal.
杏子姐，你在这儿干吗？
'Sister Xingzi, what are you doing here?' Surprised "ni zai zher ganma?" sounds warm between friendly colleagues even though the same words sounded stern from Chun Yuqiao earlier.
后备方案也行不通了！
'The backup plan fell through too!' Vivid "xingbutong" literally says 'walk not through' — like a road that is blocked — the everyday expression for a plan that won't work.
杏子姐，是我，我要道歉。
'Sister Xingzi, it was my fault — I need to apologise.' Remember "daoqian" for 'apologise', while short "shi wo" ('it was me') owns up to a mistake directly.
道歉？道什么歉？
'Apologise? Apologise for what?' Just like "kai shenme wanxiao", Mandarin splits separable word "daoqian" apart into "dao shenme qian" to ask 'apologise for what?'
吉秀看到了，一定是我泄露了消息。
'Ji Xiu saw it — it must have been me who leaked the news.' Strong certainty uses "yiding shi...", 'it must be...', while "kandao" adds "dao" onto "kan" to mean actually catch sight of something.
被我全搞砸了，我该怎么办啊？
'I ruined the whole thing — what should I do?' Colloquial "gaoza" literally means 'smash by doing' — 'botch' or 'mess everything up' — introduced by "bei wo", 'by me'.
你别哭啊，放心吧！
'Do not cry — rest easy!' Comfort a friend with "bie ku", 'don't cry', and reassuring "fangxin ba", literally 'set your heart down' — 'don't worry!'.
我们已经在录制了，担心都是多余的。
'We are already taping; all that worry is unnecessary.' Combining "yijing", 'already', with "zai... le" announces that taping is underway right now, and "duoyu" means 'superfluous' or 'unneeded'.
现在吗？复活赛不是明天才录吗？

'Right now? Is the revival round not supposed to tape tomorrow?' Notice "cai" in "mingtian cai lu": unlike "jiu" ('already so soon'), "cai" means 'not until tomorrow'. Now listen to the whole studio-corridor twist once more.
杏子姐，你在这儿干吗？
后备方案也行不通了！
杏子姐，是我，我要道歉。
道歉？道什么歉？
吉秀看到了，一定是我泄露了消息。
被我全搞砸了，我该怎么办啊？
你别哭啊，放心吧！
我们已经在录制了，担心都是多余的。
现在吗？复活赛不是明天才录吗？
Both Yin Zhengyu and Plan B were decoys all along — Chun Yuqiao moved the real taping a day early! You learned "daoqian", comforting "fangxin ba", and "cai" for "not until".
明天见！
